svg.title: OptionNbboQuote packet layout
svg.text: 140 bytes, fixed size · little-endian, packed · offsets from message start

g.title: Header
Header
okey: OptionKey, offset 28, 27 bytes - option key (ticker + expiry + strike + call/put)
okey: OptionKey, offset 28, 27 bytes - option key (ticker + expiry + strike + call/put)

g.data-desc: what changed on this update (price, size or both)
g.title: updateType: enum UpdateType, offset 55, 1 bytes - what changed on this update (price, size or both)
bidPrice: float32, offset 56, 4 bytes - bid price
askPrice: float32, offset 60, 4 bytes - ask price

g.data-desc: bid size in contracts (largest exch quote)
g.title: bidSize: int32, offset 64, 4 bytes - bid size in contracts (largest exch quote)

g.data-desc: ask size in contracts (largest exch quote)
g.title: askSize: int32, offset 68, 4 bytes - ask size in contracts (largest exch quote)

g.data-desc: bid size in contracts (total nbbo size)
g.title: cumBidSize: int32, offset 72, 4 bytes - bid size in contracts (total nbbo size)

g.data-desc: ask size in contracts (total nbbo size)
g.title: cumAskSize: int32, offset 76, 4 bytes - ask size in contracts (total nbbo size)

g.data-desc: first (or largest remaining) exchange at bid price
g.title: bidExch: enum OptExch, offset 80, 1 bytes - first (or largest remaining) exchange at bid price

g.data-desc: first (or largest remaining) exchange at ask price
g.title: askExch: enum OptExch, offset 81, 1 bytes - first (or largest remaining) exchange at ask price
bidMask: int64, offset 82, 8 bytes - exchange bid bit mask
bidMask: int64, offset 82, 8 bytes - exchange bid bit mask
askMask: int64, offset 90, 8 bytes - exchange ask bit mask
askMask: int64, offset 90, 8 bytes - exchange ask bit mask
bidMktType: flag OptMktType, offset 98, 1 bytes - bid side quote flags (if any)
askMktType: flag OptMktType, offset 99, 1 bytes - ask side quote flags (if any)
bidPrice2: float32, offset 100, 4 bytes - 2nd best bid price
askPrice2: float32, offset 104, 4 bytes - 2nd best ask price
cumBidSize2: int32, offset 108, 4 bytes - cumulative size at 2nd price
cumAskSize2: int32, offset 112, 4 bytes - cumulative size at 2nd price

g.data-desc: last bid price change (milliseconds since midnight) calculated from the srcTimestamp
g.title: bidTime: int32, offset 116, 4 bytes - last bid price change (milliseconds since midnight) calculated from the srcTimestamp

g.data-desc: last ask price change (milliseconds since midnight) calculated from the srcTimestamp
g.title: askTime: int32, offset 120, 4 bytes - last ask price change (milliseconds since midnight) calculated from the srcTimestamp
srcTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 124, 8 bytes - source exchange high-precision timestamp (if available)
srcTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 124, 8 bytes - source exchange high-precision timestamp (if available)

g.data-desc: inbound packet PTP timestamp from SR gateway switch; synchronized with facility grandfather clock
g.title: netTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 132, 8 bytes - inbound packet PTP timestamp from SR gateway switch; synchronized with facility grandfather clock

g.data-desc: inbound packet PTP timestamp from SR gateway switch; synchronized with facility grandfather clock
g.title: netTimestamp: int64 (Unix ns), offset 132, 8 bytes - inbound packet PTP timestamp from SR gateway switch; synchronized with facility grandfather clock
